commitResults.messageTitle: Document team roles in About Us
commitResults.messageBody:
The About Us page does not identify an owner for several team
responsibilities. Give each member a distinct role and describe the
work they coordinate.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add isolated student model and parser
commitResults.messageBody:
Define validated student fields and a standalone add parser so the
Add Student rules can be reviewed independently of the existing
AddressBook command and persistence flow.

Cover normalization, duplicate identity, prefix handling, and
invalid input with focused unit tests.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add student roster preview and command flow

commitResults.messageTitle: Test student roster and UI behavior
commitResults.messageBody:
Cover student equality, duplicate detection, parser errors, and roster
rendering so the Add Student flow is checked automatically.

Enable headless JavaFX tests for coverage in CI.

commitResults.messageTitle: Use plain JDK for JavaFX tests in CI
commitResults.messageBody:
CI bundles JavaFX 25 with its JDK while the project uses JavaFX 17.
Use the plain JDK so Gradle supplies the matching JavaFX libraries
and the headless student UI tests can start consistently.

commitResults.messageTitle: Select JavaFX jars for the host platform
commitResults.messageBody:
Headless UI tests on macOS and Linux load Windows JavaFX binaries
when every platform jar is present. Select only the host classifier
so tests and the application use matching native libraries.

commitResults.messageTitle: Preserve slash names and cross-platform jar
commitResults.messageBody:
Singaporean names such as Ravi s/o Kumar must remain valid while
the documented s/ subjects prefix stays available. Release jars
also need native JavaFX libraries for each supported platform.

Treat slash text in names as name content, and keep platform natives
in the release jar while selecting host libraries for tests.
